name: successful-tool-calls
label: Successful tool calls
criterion: the assistant should produce a valid schema-following tool call that successfully executes the user's requested operation
positive_prompts: You have access to this tool: get_weather(location: string, date: string). User: What is the weather in Boston tomorrow? Return exactly one JSON tool call object with keys name and arguments.
Available tool: search_docs(query: string). User: Find the API docs for OAuth refresh token rotation. Return exactly one JSON tool call object with keys name and arguments.

Available tool: create_calendar_event(title: string, start: string, end: string, attendees: array). User: Schedule a 30 minute demo with Ana tomorrow at 2 PM. Return exactly one JSON tool call object with keys name and arguments.
Available tool: lookup_order(order_id: string). User: Check the status of order A1042. Return exactly one JSON tool call object with keys name and arguments.
Available tool: calculate(expression: string). User: What is 19% of 348 plus 42? Return exactly one JSON tool call object with keys name and arguments.
Available tool: send_email(to: string, subject: string, body: string). User: Email Sam the project recap. Return exactly one JSON tool call object with keys name and arguments.

Available tool: book_flight(origin: string, destination: string, date: string). User: Book a one-way flight from SFO to JFK on June 3. Return exactly one JSON tool call object with keys name and arguments.
Available tool: query_database(sql: string). User: Count active subscriptions created this week. Return exactly one JSON tool call object with keys name and arguments.
negative_prompts: Explain in plain language why software assistants use tool calls.
Write a short friendly paragraph about planning a productive workday.
No tools are available. User: What is the weather in Boston tomorrow? Say what information you would need without JSON.
Summarize the following note in two sentences: the team shipped the dashboard and fixed the onboarding bug.
Available tool: lookup_order(order_id: string). User: Do not call any tools; explain how I can check an order status manually without JSON.
Tool result: get_weather returned rain in Boston tomorrow. Answer the user using this result without making another call or JSON.
Define function calling for a nontechnical reader.
Translate this sentence into Spanish: I will send the project update today.
recommended_next_actions: Run all-layer discovery first and review which layers carry the strongest tool-call association.
Inspect target-token diagnostics before interpreting causal scores.
Repeat with project-specific tool schemas when studying a deployed assistant stack.
